searchProps.placementDefinition: Distinct actual container-bound variants, including authored interior asset overrides.

adjustments.reason: Move the existing quayside patrol out of the newly authored cargo container and into the clear rear quay. Preserve identity, health, inventory and mission state.

assets.scope: All stored GLBs, base64 GLB banks and barrier JSON; library totals are not per-frame budgets.
assets.geometryBytesDefinition: Unique primitive bufferView byteLength; JSON arrays assume 32-bit values. Excludes images/animations.
assets.payloadBytesDefinition: fileBytes counts decoded GLB bytes within base64 banks; modelFileTransferBytes counts actual unique model/bank files.
limitations: Stored mesh triangles exclude node/scene instance multiplication
Source-manifest counts can describe discarded modules; actual stored counts are separate
